purpose: result-blind verification of historical CellPhoneDB input and runtime database identity
acceptable_expression_evidence: exact paired expression and metadata exports used in the historical run
deterministic generating script plus immutable source object or layer and full transformation provenance
acceptable_database_evidence: exact runtime database file with sha256
immutable database release identifier plus matching hash
run-binding log that unambiguously identifies the selected database
prohibited_substitutions: processed H5AD used as the historical count input without equivalence evidence
clean-install database treated as the historical runtime database without binding evidence
outcome-guided search for an input or database that reproduces a published result
